revision_selection: Receiver-owned policy selects the exact carrier revision and verifier before interpretation. The shared predicateType never selects a revision. No fallback, default, or rewrite of a legacy record. The 01 pilot profile refuses evaluation or oversight members as a local dispatch restriction; this is not an intrinsic AAR-01 malformed verdict.
target: urn:aar-pilot:record:<SHA256 exact envelope bytes>:request:<recomputed requestDigest>. This identifies the exact signed report's action reference, not a globally unique physical execution or a join across records.
logical_equality: All opaque target, context, profile, basis-reference and limitation atoms use exact Unicode codepoint equality, scoped by this immutable profile revision; no Unicode normalization, URI dereference, aliases, case folding or cross-profile equality is inferred. Digest atoms contain lowercase hexadecimal. Logical collections are sets, compared after duplicate elimination; JSON array order is only a deterministic representation. The profile identity is profile_id plus SHA256 of these exact profile bytes. Reformatting an envelope changes the record-scoped target even if its signed Statement is unchanged; cross-record joins are outside this profile.
boundary: After native validation under the pinned receiver key, attributed grounding is accepted only for the reporting boundary, with ceiling observation. Declared below-observed vantage and derived authoritative native tier do not independently establish an execution-relevant boundary.

base_predicates.observation: Native signature, full selected-reader validation, recomputed request digest and subject binding establish that an authenticated canonical Statement reports an event concerning its exact action reference. DSSE authenticates the canonical Statement preimage; the raw-envelope hash is only the local artifact identity. No fact about action occurrence is inferred.
base_predicates.intent: Needs an authenticated decision-point artifact binding the exact action and arguments. The single observer envelope and its decision field do not supply that artifact; semantic assessment is not-evaluated.
base_predicates.invocation: Needs evidence of the exact invocation crossing an established invocation boundary. No such independently established boundary artifact is supplied; semantic assessment is not-evaluated.
base_predicates.execution: Needs evidence at an established execution-relevant controlled boundary for this exact action. Self-described vantage, internal recomputes and a trusted signature do not supply external boundary establishment; semantic assessment is not-evaluated.

qualifiers: All admissible IV roles and execution PROV are explicitly not-evaluated: the packet supplies no accepted independent verification or provenance predicate. Different test keys and a carried oversight digest do not supply IV.
native_facets: Preserve decision-point evaluation (including unavailable inputs), reported decision, observed effect, agreement and producer-asserted oversight independently of Core appraisal status. Authorization validity, nonoccurrence and human participation are not Core bases.
core_slice: Reuse the exact existing HOF partial evaluator only for complete inputs produced by this closed profile: one supported observation, no positive qualifiers, requested execution not supported with its semantic assessment not-evaluated, no composition and no supplied counter-evidence. A profile-specific guard precedes invocation. This is not full Core conformance or a standardized mapper-to-evaluator interface.
counter_evidence: The input packet contains only the selected record and policy. Discovery is bounded to that packet and returns not-supplied. A separate test oracle is never silently inserted into the participants' evidence. This does not show no counter-evidence exists.
scope_exclusions: No authorization-policy evaluation, live standing/key/consumption-source lookup, oversight-record resolution, timestamp-anchor validation, completeness or retention audit.
No PROV/IV qualification, composition, general carrier conformance, real deployment execution verification or external implementation interoperability.
The native reader rejects floats as outside its implemented value space; the draft's I-JSON/JCS text is broader. Passing the published vectors does not establish all JSON/schema behavior.
The native reader does not verify priorCommitment.sig; the draft does not specify its signing preimage.
